⚑ S1 stat routing: "Charge Damage Multiplier ▲" is read as chargeDamageMultPct (scales BASE charge damage, the multiplier lane), NOT the additive chargeDamagePct lane. Wording match is on "Multiplier"; unconfirmed against a popup.

Note damageTakenPct in the schema is the BOSS-side debuff (positive = boss takes more); an ally-side incoming-damage reduction is a different sign and a different consumer, so it is NOT encoded with that stat.

flags.estimate: {kind:'interval', sec:20} (stand-in); real cadence = time for the boss to land 20 attacks on this unit
flags.reasoning: 'Activates when attacked 20 time(s)' is an incoming-hit counter. The sim models an immortal boss that deals no tracked damage to units, so there is no 'attacked' event channel — the trigger is outside the input domain entirely. An interval is the closest available primitive; sec:20 is chosen so the 20s buff has ~100% uptime (an optimistic-but-plausible support assumption), NOT because 20 attacks are known to take 20s. If the boss's attack cadence on a single unit is slower, this OVER-CREDITS the whole team's charge damage.
flags.recipe: From scope-lock footage, count boss attacks that land on the Admi slot over the 180s fight → attacks/sec; re-fire period = 20 / that rate. Then set interval sec to that period (or, if the period exceeds 20s, accept sub-100% uptime rather than a permanent buff). Alternative: run a full-charge-carry comp with and without Admi and back out the effective uptime from the charge-bucket delta.

flags.reasoning: The kit says 'Charge Damage Multiplier', matching the multiplier lane's description (scales by BASE charge damage) rather than the additive-percentage-points lane. This is a wording-based routing call, not a measurement — the two lanes give materially different numbers on a charge carry, so if the wording convention is wrong the whole contribution is mis-sized.
flags.recipe: Run a single charge-weapon carry solo, record one full-charge popup with and without a 9.59% Admi buff active. Additive lane → the popup rises by 9.59 percentage points of the charge bucket's summed percentage; multiplier lane → it rises by 9.59% of the BASE charge damage. Compare the observed delta against both predictions.

flags.reasoning: Per the trigger-identity rule, effects in a unit's own burst block with no 'entering Full Burst' clause are burst-cast: they fire only on rotations where THIS unit bursts. Admi is Burst II, so in a comp with a second B2 she may not cast every rotation and keying to fullBurstEnter would over-credit. Low residual risk — but it is a reading of the block's position, not of an explicit activation clause.
flags.recipe: Two-B2 comp footage: check whether the Reload Speed / Crit Damage buff icons appear on allies during rotations where the OTHER B2 casts. Present on every FB → fullBurstEnter; present only on Admi's own casts → burstCast (as modeled).
